title: PORCINE lumbar motion segment diagonal stiffness, isolated disc (posterior elements removed), 0/200/400 N preload

quantity.name: diagonal terms of the 6x6 stiffness matrix
quantity.definition: Least-squares symmetric 6x6 stiffness (21 coefficients) at the centre of the upper vertebral body, lower vertebra fixed; diagonal terms relate force/moment to the collinear displacement/rotation. Axes aligned to the vertebral body centres from biplanar radiographs. Displacements +-0.3 mm A-P and lateral, +-0.2 mm axial, +-1 deg lateral bending, +-0.8 deg flexion-extension and torsion.

source.n: 6 porcine lumbar motion segments (animals >16 weeks old; levels not stated)
source.sample: PORCINE lumbar motion segments in vitro (animal, not human)

protocol.summary: Hexapod robot, 6 pure-displacement tests, 4 sawtooth cycles of 87 s, 1 Hz sampling, isotonic saline bath ~4 C, axial preload 0/200/400 N (order permuted; >=3 h equilibration; vertical displacement with horizontal adjustment to zero shear).
how_to_simulate: Build a porcine lumbar motion segment model (animal; do not compare with human data)
Fix the lower vertebra; reference point = centre of the upper vertebral body
Apply 0, 200 or 400 N axial compression and equilibrate; remove facets and posterior ligaments first

Impose each pure displacement with the other DOF fixed (+-0.3 mm A-P/lateral, +-0.2 mm axial, +-1 deg lateral bending, +-0.8 deg flexion-extension/torsion) and report the slope of collinear force/moment vs displacement
protocol.notes: Primary off-diagonal terms (A-P shear/flexion, lateral shear/lateral bending) only reported as ratios in text (x1.4 and x1.6 with 200/400 N intact; x3.5 and x5.4 isolated disc). At 400 N compressive stress ~0.5 MPa. SE given in figure; sd = SE*sqrt(6) (derived).

data.note: value from text (p.549: 37 N/mm, not significantly different from zero); digitised bar = 41 N/mm

extraction.uncertainty: N/mm terms +-30 N/mm (1 px = 14 N/mm at 300 dpi); Nm/deg terms +-0.05 Nm/deg; SE +-1-2 px; SE set null where the cap overlaps the bar top (< 2 px)
extraction.check_notes: Digitised by pixel analysis (300 dpi render, bar-top line centre vs axis tick centres); two passes (raw edge vs line-centre corrected) differed by <=1 px (14 N/mm, 0.07 Nm/deg in Fig 2), within stated uncertainty. Ratios check against text: intact axial 200/0 = 4.7 (text 4.7), 400/0 = 6.4 (text 6.4); lateral bending 2.4/3.5 (text 2.4/3.5); flexion-extension 2.0/2.7 (text 2.0/2.7). Isolated disc A-P shear at 0 N: text 37 N/mm vs digitised 41.
